name: New Mexico

ties.applies_to: all kinds of office and measures
ties.note: The official New Mexico code site (New Mexico OneSource, run by the Compilation Commission) serves a script shell on its navigation page and answered HTTP 403 to its home page; the one compilation allowed by the coordinator's amendment of 07:21 UTC (Justia) had already refused us (see unread). A web search, used only to find citations, returned NMSA sections in Chapter 1, Article 14 (canvass and recounts: 1-14-14, 1-14-23, 1-14-24) and Article 13 (1-13-9, 1-13-11); these are leads to citations, not readings, and no text of them was read.

unread.what: all of New Mexico's tie and recount law (NMSA 1978 Chapter 1, Article 14 and the primary articles)
unread.reason: https://nmonesource.com/nmos/en/nav.do: the helper reported "only 128 characters of text (a script shell or an empty page)"; https://nmonesource.com/: "HTTP 403"; https://nmonesource.com/nmos/nmsa/en/nav.do: HTTP 404 (a guessed address). Stopped at the first refusal on that host. No plain downloadable file of the statutes was found on the sites' public pages: the New Mexico Legislature's site (nmlegis.gov) holds bills, which show the sections only as amended by each bill, not the codified statutes, and was not used.

unread.what: the same law, from a compilation allowed by the amendment of 2026-11-07 07:21 UTC
unread.reason: Justia answered HTTP 403 to its first request in this task (https://law.justia.com/codes/new-hampshire/title-lxiii/, for New Hampshire at 2026-11-07T07:22Z); stopped at that refusal and made no request to Justia for New Mexico. Cornell LII was not tried for New Mexico: a search of that site for the New Jersey statutes returned only New Jersey regulations, and no search of it was made for New Mexico.
unread.url: https://law.justia.com/codes/new-hampshire/title-lxiii/ (the refused request; no New Mexico URL was requested)
